8. पाठ्य प्रश्न (5) and सुलेख (३) have no printed instruction line; the block instruction is empty.
9. Paper-only: सुलेख (३) is copied on the printout and marked by the parent with a rubric. Circling in वर्तनी अ) becomes a choice on the site.
10. No pictures (only the school emblem on page 1).
